rca.defect: The exact intersection of individually narrow runner and collector offset envelopes is physically brittle even though all independent anchors form a stable all-point affine clock relation inside the frozen residual, drift, and step bounds.
rca.remediation: Before another runtime, freeze a deterministic centered-OLS model over every runner and collector nonce anchor using exact rational arithmetic. Require drift <=100 ppm, every residual <=1000000 ns, consecutive residual step <=2000000 ns, and project through a conservative interval derived from the observed maximum residual plus anchor half-width and rounding. Keep causal intervals non-overlapping.
rca.threshold_change_scope: clock projection model only; causal ordering, actor identity, durable effect, and workload thresholds remain unchanged
